completion:
Include the engineering consulting report.
3. Create the mapping table of subtasks (see example in page 2).
4. Create the mapping table responsible for the list of buildings (see example in page 3).
5. Create maps of completed subtasks and combine them into the final target map (see example in page 4). # reminding
# building fire safety

After conducting the inspection and pinning down checking the buildings and its construction parts to meet the requirements of the current standards specified in the request, if it is found that the building does not meet the requirements for fire safety during the inspection, make out act and write about that fact in accordance with the results obtained.

You need to indicate the document in accordance with which the check was carried out, indicating its name and date of issuance.

Also put the information on the purpose of the check, the specific list of documents and the results obtained during the review, check them
